summary: The sole new record confirms existing III.1: livestock as subject of dung-dropping, with no expressed object. The collective u sawal does not justify a new participant sense.
94/81 is already represented in the Infectum box. The coordinated komašrəʕ is a different verb and does not establish another brʕ form.
The inherited denomination and Infinitiv tēbriʕo remain unchanged. No new idiom, sense, form box or correction is supported by this occurrence.
